criteria.evidence: It advises logging failures and examining the pipeline (descriptions, tool count, schemas, prompt, model, results), and asks for the framework/tool list. But it doesn't trace the user's actual architecture, since none was available; it offers a generic checklist.
Explicitly says "Find the first wrong boundary" and lists boundaries to inspect (descriptions, tool set, schemas, prompt, model, tool results) with logging of failures to localize it.
Opens with "Probably none. Switching frameworks is unlikely to fix this," recommends cheap fixes in order, and says a switch only makes sense if diagnosis shows a framework-specific problem.
